stem: Which statement describes one of the MOST important reasons why the United States annexed the Kingdom of Hawaii?

options.label: A
options.text: The islands offered excellent locations for tropical resorts.

options.label: B
options.text: The local residents needed help to prevent the spread of poverty and disease.

options.label: C
options.text: The location was strategically valuable to both military and business leaders.

options.label: D
options.text: The local rulers wanted financial assistance to rebuild after a natural disaster.
